summary: Three things stuck out of reach, each painted into an edit of its area's approved painting and cut by the kit as an added prop (hidden by default; no hole in the plate): Rosie's kite on the park's play tower, a bottle past the end of Sue's dock, and the cocoa seller's scarf on a ski-lift chair.
generationSource: Generated with Gemini as edits of the approved paintings, so the new objects share their paint, light, and registration; no open source has them in this style (docs/media-sources.md is for sounds and photos).

edits.prompt: This is a finished hand-painted watercolour-and-ink painting of a place in a cozy children's game. Keep the whole painting EXACTLY as it is: the same composition and framing, every object, colour, line, and the paper border, at exactly the same size and position. Change only one thing: add a child's kite tangled at the very top of the stone play tower's flagpole, on the right of the picture, right beside the little tattered flag: a diamond-shaped kite in pink and sunny yellow, its string wound around the top of the pole, and its long ribbon tail with small bows hanging down the pole toward the tower's battlements. Paint the new object in the same soft watercolour with thin warm-brown ink outlines, at a believable size for the scene. No people, no animals, no text or letters. Output the whole image at the same framing.
edits.note: The first kite: a big kite flying from the top of the flagpole. Too big, and set where only Fae's head would reach it.

postProcessing.art/source/areas/park/park-kite.png: The park's own pipeline (art/recipes/park.json): magick <raw> -resize 3000x -gravity center -crop 3000x2000+0+0 +repage.
postProcessing.art/source/areas/pass/pass-scarf.png: The pass's: magick <raw> -background '#fcfbf6' -gravity south -extent 2528x1900 -resize x2200 -gravity center -extent 3500x2200. (art/recipes/pass.json says the pad goes at the bottom; the plate has it at the top, which is what -gravity south gives: that command reproduces the plate at a mean difference of 1.27, the tiles' WebP noise, and the bottom-padded one at 31.)
